settings.seeds_source: three Gaussian directions per fine-tune (card n = 3), enough for a spread per fine-tune and the 2-of-3 majority in min_scored; 88 fine-tunes give 264 draws
settings.match_source: E46 Amendment 1's filed values (experiments/regating_table/results/predictions_amend1.json: kl_rel_tol 0.1, scale_cap 100) with E46's matcher commute.perturb.match and direction commute.finetune.random_direction (each matrix's Gaussian at the fine-tune's per-matrix Frobenius norm)
settings.batch_source: memory only; E136's read batch for the kv and E62 tasks
settings.split_tol_source: commute.split.bases' default, used by every least-squares split on the 67M; alive set: round 1's (experiments/transport_test/results/large/alive.pt, vpd.alive_masks, mean causal importance over 1e-6, the paper's rule)

items.pairs: E187's nine built pairs (experiments/size_matched/run.py BUILT and pairs(): e62_copy_lookup, e46_copy_random, e53_lowercase_cipher, e54_matched, e54_own, open_pair_c3, open_pair_c3_copy, e58_rank1_96, e58_copy_prior_cipher), every saved seed of both sides, as the scorecard
items.twins: the scorecard's four shuffled-label twins (experiments/method_table/scorecard.py, panel 2): e58_elicit_shuffle and e58_class_twin (E147's saved 96-key states, 3 seeds a side), e123_case_label and e125_repeat_label (E136's case_label and fresh_reuse_pair states, 2 seeds a side); these four because they are the twin panel the paper's scorecard already reads and every one of their states is saved
items.states: 88 unique fine-tunes (some states sit in two pairs: e54's elicit side, c3's cipher side)
items.random: per fine-tune, the three seeds' Gaussian directions, each scaled so KL(W0 + c R || W0), mean per row and position over every position up to the read position of the fine-tune's read rows, equals the fine-tune's within 10% (c <= 100)
items.structured control: per fine-tune, one change of h.3.mlp.down_proj alone (the last decomposed matrix: no decomposed matrix reads its output, so Gamma's gates cannot move and K01 = K00), a Gaussian with its part outside the alive span removed (split.obstruction; the split expresses the rest), at the fine-tune's total norm, scaled to the same KL. Why this one: it is the one change of matched size whose re-gating numerator is zero by construction while the split carries it, so the KL-form share must read 0 and the rule must call it 'low'; it checks that the rule can say 'low' at all

thresholds.thresholds_source: reproduce_tol: E143's and E211's filed tolerance on r (E211 re-read 0.7538 against 0.7519 saved); band_min: E161's batch sd of r (experiments/share_stability/results/run.json .stage1_step10.sd_r), used only when a measured band is degenerate; min_scored: 2 of 3 draws, a majority; control_gate_tol: K01 = K00 holds exactly by construction (the same cached inputs, the same gates), so 1e-6 relative only allows GPU summation order

readings.kl_share (primary): E57's re-gating share (experiments/qwen_reading/lab.py cells, commute.qwen_reading.shares; reports/analyses/2026-10-30_analysis_e57-reading-the-update.md) on the 67M, commute.masked_reads.route_cells_by: per row, KL summed over every position up to the read position; T1 the changed model's own forward; the CI-masked model, Delta out: K0 = KL(T0 || masked C0, W0's gates), K00 = KL(T1 || masked C0, W0's gates), K01 = KL(T1 || masked C0, the changed model's gates), K10 = KL(T1 || masked C1, W0's gates), K11 = KL(T1 || masked C1, the gates of the changed model carrying C1); C1 the components carrying the change's least-squares split onto the alive subcomponents. kl_share = (K00 - K01) / (K00 - K11); nan when K00 - K11 <= 0; E45's status ('scored' / 'unscored', floor 0.05 nats per position) reported, not used
readings.r (secondary): GOALS.md Terms r on the same forwards: (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0) in log-odds of the trained answer at the read position, nan under a gain of 1 (MIN_GAIN)

expected.fine-tunes' r: each within 0.01 of its saved share (E136 stage1 .trained; E147's saved reads for the e58 states)
expected.fine-tunes' kl_share: finite (the split closes part of the gap); no 67M reference; Qwen's fine-tunes read 0.990-0.9998 (P3.8); expected 0.3 to 1.0, low confidence
expected.bands: r about 0.02-0.06; kl_share measured, no prior
expected.random draws, kl_share: finite on most draws; a random change is mostly outside the alive span, which makes K11 close to K01 and the share close to 1 (as on Qwen), so draws near or above the fine-tunes' own: K1 'rival b: reaches' (lean, low-medium confidence)
expected.random draws, r: gain on the trained answer under 1 on most draws (E211's norm-matched Gaussians at most 0.075, E46's KL-matched ones -0.20 to +0.49): P1 'silent: refused', confidence medium
expected.structured control: kl_share 0 (numerator exactly 0, K00 - K11 > 0), 'low' on every fine-tune where it matched: control check 'pass'; r 0 where its gain reaches 1, else nan
expected.pairs (descriptive): r separates as the scorecard did (5 of the scored pairs); kl_share: no prior
expected.time: see the plan's runtime table: about 25-35 s a fine-tune on 75-200 rows and 60-90 s on E53's 500 rows (own read, three draws and the control, each a KL match of at most 52 plain-forward evaluations, a split and one pass of seven CI or masked forwards per batch); measured in the rehearsal before the scored pods

P0 (stops).rule: exit 1 unless: (a) first in every job, a zero change on its first state's rows reads r's numerator and gain, the KL, K00 - K0, K01 - K0, K10 - K00 and K11 - K01 exactly 0; (b) per state, before its draws, the fine-tune's r reproduces its saved share within reproduce_tol; (c) per state, the structured control reads |K01 - K00| <= control_gate_tol x K00 (its construction).
P0 (stops).blind_to: whether either share means reuse; they check the readers, the split's application, each state's identity, and the control's construction
P0 (stops).positive_control: (b) the saved fine-tunes for r; the structured control for the 'low' verdict

band.rule: per reading, band = the root mean square over the fine-tunes of |reading(half 1) - reading(half 2)| (halves by split_seed, each summed on its own rows from the fine-tune's one pass; about twice the sd of a whole-row reading); fine-tunes with a nan half are left out; degenerate (none finite, or 0): band_min.

verdict per fine-tune and reading.rule: readable draws: match status 'ok' and a finite reading (kl_share: K00 - K11 > 0; r: gain at least 1). The fine-tune's own reading not finite, or fewer than min_scored readable draws: 'refused'. Otherwise 'low' if every readable draw is below the fine-tune's own reading minus the band, strictly; else 'reaches'.
verdict per fine-tune and reading.edge_cases: empty pool or all unreadable: 'refused'; ties: a draw exactly at own - band is not below it: 'reaches'; zero denominator: kl_share nan when K00 - K11 is 0 or negative, r nan under a gain of 1; an unmatched draw (cap, no match, or a non-positive unscaled KL): not readable; the do-nothing state against the bar: a zero change reads both shares nan, so 'refused', never 'low' ('refused' is reported as silent, not as a pass)

K1 (PRIMARY: does the KL-form share read.rule: over the fine-tunes not 'refused': none 'reaches': 'rival a: low'; more than half 'reaches': 'rival b: reaches'; otherwise 'mixed: n of m reach' (named in the answer paragraph); all refused: 'silent: refused'. The answer paragraph states K1, its counts and which pairs' fine-tunes reach.
K1 (PRIMARY: does the KL-form share read.edge_cases: as the verdict; states not yet written are left out and the count of planned against read is reported

control check.rule: the structured control's kl_share is below the fine-tune's own kl_share minus the kl_share band on every fine-tune where it matched: 'pass'; else 'miss' (the rule cannot say 'low', or the construction failed), reported before K1 is read.
control check.edge_cases: no matched control: 'miss'; a fine-tune whose own kl_share is nan: the comparison is false, so 'miss' there

rules.pairs (descriptive, reported): per pair and reading, E51's pair rule on the fine-tunes' own readings (|mean reuse - mean new| > the larger side's range, strict; sign reported; 'not read' if any reading is nan); no reuse or new verdict
rules.reported, not scored: every change's c, matched KL, five K cells per position, E45's status, r's gain and numerator; the readable draws' sd per fine-tune

blind_to.kl_share: what the change does to the trained answer; a change mostly outside the alive span leaves K11 near K01 and the share near 1 whatever it is
blind_to.r: any change whose rise in the trained answer is under 1 log-odds, which a random change of matched output size usually is
blind_to.match: the direction of the change: two changes of the same KL can move the outputs differently
